across_options.issue: The hairline-card option also widens the gradient action band: approximately x=164–859 instead of x=180–845. Its left and right edges and lower corners now belong to the outer card. The buttons remain essentially in place, so the field padding and amount of color change along with the surface treatment.

Both state variants move the bottom navigation divider from approximately y=1378 to y=1346, with the tab icons, labels, central plus and home indicator also moving upward by about 32 image pixels. This changes lower-screen spacing independently of the photo state treatment.
The corner-tag variant also changes the photo silhouette: each rounded upper-left photo corner becomes square beneath the tag. This is a visible geometry change in addition to the badge shape.
